prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept / style-transfer.
Create one finished reusable full-body portrait of Severin, Regent of Lorne, topic C01-CHAR-SEVERIN, native 1024x1536 PNG with genuine transparent RGBA background. The whole figure and all objects must fit uncropped with at least 40 pixels of empty transparent margin on every side.
Reference1 is the exact historical Severin card: use ONLY this named older male character's face, swept gray hair, short full gray beard and mustache, thick brows, warm tan skin, calm reserved expression, three-quarter standing pose and the bundle of thick brown administrative ledgers with a large dull red wax seal held against his torso on viewer-right. Reference2 is an approved game character for STYLE ONLY: match its big readable head and hands, short sturdy cartoon proportions about four heads tall, strong clean dark contour, chunky matte painted color masses, broad simple light/shadow facets. Do not copy reference2's female face, hood, religious motifs or lantern.
Critical narrative correction to reference1: Severin is a tired working political regent, not a warrior or pleasure-loving crowned king. Replace the ornate gold-trimmed armored coat and visible chainmail with PLAIN practical political clothing: simple cream long coat with restrained muted burgundy side panels and lining, dark warm charcoal cloth tunic, plain brown belt and sturdy brown boots. The cream/burgundy colors and ledger pose preserve his historical identity. No gold edge trim, no royal jewelry, no crown-shaped clasp, no armor, no weapon and no crown on his head. A simple inconspicuous cloth fastening is sufficient. Slightly rumpled broad cloth folds, understated worn sleeve edges, no granular dirt. His gray hair and short rounded beard match the first reference; do not change him into Roderick the square-armored knight. Tired lower eyelids, concerned thoughtful brow, closed mouth, quietly resolved; no villain sneer, smile, red eyes or manic emotion. Keep his lowered hand at viewer-left and his other hand supporting the complete sealed records at viewer-right. Preserve the ledger red wax disc as a broad simple administrative mark, with no added emblem or readable lettering.
The head, face, hands and books must read at very small game-card sizes. Use matte midtones, simple large shapes, a few broad painterly facets and bold smooth contour. No tiny filigree, fine scratch noise, photorealistic texture, gritty grain, or glossy 3D rendering.
Render ONLY the isolated complete character. No ground, floor, cast/contact shadow, aura, haze, glow, white/black rectangle, scenery, vignette, border, frame, text, watermark or painted checkerboard. Actual alpha transparency all around the silhouette and at every canvas edge. Do not reproduce the old parchment background. Preserve all of the authored canvas.
